mapper.select: SELECT s.WORKFLOW_ID, d.WORKFLOW_NAME, s.CRON, s.ENABLE_FLAG, s.CREATED_BY, s.CREATION_DATE, s.LAST_UPDATED_BY, s.LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM WF_SCHEDULER s LEFT JOIN WF_DEFINITIONS d ON s.WORKFLOW_ID = d.WORKFLOW_ID WHERE s.WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId}
SELECT WORKFLOW_ID, CRON, ENABLE_FLAG, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM WF_SCHEDULER WHERE ENABLE_FLAG = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WF_SCHEDULER ( WORKFLOW_ID, CRON, ENABLE_FLAG, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{workflowId}, #{cron}, #{enableFlag}, #{createdBy}, #{creationDate}, #{lastUpdatedBy}, #{lastUpdateDate} )
mapper.update: UPDATE WF_SCHEDULER SET CRON = #{cron}, ENABLE_FLAG = #{enableFlag}, LAST_UPDATED_BY = #{lastUpdatedBy}, LAST_UPDATE_DATE = #{lastUpdateDate} WHERE WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId}
mapper.select: SELECT WORKFLOW_ID FROM WF_SCHEDULER sched WHERE exists ( SELECT 1 FROM WF_INSTANCES inst WHERE sched.WORKFLOW_ID = inst.WORKFLOW_ID and inst.STATUS IN ('RUNNING', 'WAITING', 'WAIT') )
SELECT COUNT(WORKFLOW_ID) FROM WF_SCHEDULER WHERE ENABLE_FLAG = 'Y'
